SELECT s.school_name, s.DOC, 
       (s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) AS diff
FROM schools s
WHERE s.DOC IN (
  SELECT s.DOC
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
AND (s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) > (
  SELECT AVG(s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17))
)

SELECT school, s.fundingtype 
FROM schools s 
WHERE school IN (
  SELECT school 
  FROM satscores 
  WHERE dname = 'Riverside Unified School District' 
  AND avgscrmath > 400
)
AND s.fundingtype IN (
  SELECT fundingtype 
  FROM schools 
  WHERE county = 'Riverside County'
)
SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.Name = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  s.school_name, 
  AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_score_in_writing, 
  sc.phone AS communication_number
FROM 
  schools s
  JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE 
  s.OpenDate > '1991' AND s.ClosedDate < '2000'
GROUP BY 
  s.school_name, 
  sc.phone
ORDER BY 
  avg_score_in_writing DESC

SELECT T1.Street, T1.MailStrAbr
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath = (
  SELECT AVG(AvgScrMath)
  FROM satscores
  ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC
  LIMIT 6
)

SELECT S.State, COUNT(S.enrollment) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM schools S
JOIN satscores AS S ON S.cds = S.cds
WHERE S.DOC = 31
GROUP BY S.State
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM posts P

JOIN users U ON PH.UserId = U.Id

  SELECT t2.ExcerptPostId 
  FROM posts p 
  JOIN tags t2 ON p.Id = t2.ExcerptPostId 
  WHERE t2.OwnerDisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' 
  AND t2.TagName NOT IN (
    SELECT t3.TagName 
    FROM comments c 
    JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id 
    WHERE p.OwnerDisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' 
    AND c.CommentCount = 0
  )
)
AND t.TagName NOT IN (
  SELECT t2.TagName 
  FROM comments c 
  JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id

)

SELECT CAST(
  (
    SELECT CAST(
      (LandonDonovan.overall_rating - JordanBowery.overall_rating) AS REAL
    ) / (LandonDonovan.overall_rating + JordanBowery.overall_rating) * 100
    FROM Player_Attributes
    JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON Player_Attributes.id = PA.id
    JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
    WHERE P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND PA.overall_rating > PA.overall_rating
    AND P.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND PA.overall_rating < PA.overall_rating
  ) AS Percentage
) AS Percentage
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE Player_Attributes.player_api_id = 'Jordan Bowery' AND Player_Attributes.overall_rating > Player_Attributes.overall_rating

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_foot_players,
  SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS born_between_87_92_players,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
GROUP BY left_foot_players, born_between_87_92_players
ORDER BY left_foot_players DESC, born_between_87_92_players DESC

SELECT 
  district_id AS district, 
  state AS state, 
  (A12 - A13) / A12 * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM 
  loan
WHERE 
  status = 'D'

  AND A13 IS NOT NULL

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.client_id
WHERE T2.birth_date < (SELECT MIN(T2.birth_date) FROM client AS T3 WHERE T3.client_id = T1.account_id)
AND T1.A11 = (SELECT A11 FROM account AS T4 WHERE T4.account_id = T1.account_id ORDER BY A11 DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.amount
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.duration > 12
AND T2.district_id IN (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE date LIKE '1993%'
)
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

  COUNT(DriverID) * 100 / COUNT(DriverID) AS race_completion_percentage

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN (
  SELECT driverId, MIN(time) AS time
  FROM lapTimes
  GROUP BY driverId
) AS T2
ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId AND T1.time = T2.time
WHERE T2.time = (
  SELECT MIN(time)
  FROM (
    SELECT driverId, MIN(time) AS time
    FROM lapTimes
    GROUP BY driverId
  ) AS T1
)

FROM drivers T1
JOIN results T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId AND T2.raceId = 592
WHERE T2.time IS NOT NULL AND T2.dob IS NOT NULL

FROM drivers AS T1

  c.location AS circuitLocation, 
  c.lat, 
  c.lng

  circuits c

FROM drivers

AND races.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'
AND driverId NOT IN (

  FROM drivers

)

JOIN seasons AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId

JOIN constructorResults AS T5 ON T4.constructorId = T5.constructorId

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.expense_description, T2.cost
FROM member M
JOIN expense E ON M.member_id = E.link_to_member
JOIN budget B ON E.link_to_budget = B.budget_id
JOIN attendance A ON E.link_to_event = A.link_to_event
JOIN income I ON E.link_to_member = I.link_to_member
JOIN zip_code ZC ON I.zip_code = ZC.zip_code
JOIN major M2 ON ZC.department = M2.department
JOIN event E2 ON M2.major_id = E2.major_id
JOIN zip_code ZC2 ON E2.location = ZC2.city
JOIN member M3 ON ZC2.zip_code = M3.zip
JOIN major M3_2 ON M3.member_id = M3_2.member_id
JOIN event E3 ON M3_2.major_id = E3.major_id
JOIN zip_code ZC3 ON E3.location = ZC3.city
JOIN member M4 ON ZC3.zip_code = M4.zip
JOIN major M4_2 ON M4.member_id = M4_2.member_id
JOIN event E4 ON M4_2.major_id = E4.major_id
WHERE E.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'
AND E.cost > 0
AND M.first_name = 'Angela'
AND M.last_name = 'Gilmour

SELECT 
  m.last_name, 
  d.department_name, 
  c.college_name
FROM 
  member m
  JOIN major m2 ON m.member_id = m2.member_id
  JOIN department d ON m2.major_id = d.major_id
  JOIN college c ON d.department_id = c.department_id
WHERE 
  m.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday FROM Patient WHERE UN BETWEEN 29 AND 30

SELECT element 
FROM bond

SELECT element, label 
FROM atom 
WHERE atom_id = 'TR060'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' EXCEPT SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' AND element = 'f'

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN element = 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen' 
    ELSE 'Other' 
  END AS label,
  SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(element) AS ratio
FROM 
  atom 
WHERE 
  atom_id = 'TR006' 
GROUP BY 
  label

SELECT m.label 
FROM atom a 
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
JOIN molecule m ON c.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE a.atom_id BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND m.label = '+'
